analyst_view.overall: Borac (21st, 3 pts, beaten 2-0 by Mjallby last time out) host Atalanta (16th, 4 pts) in a game both need for a top-24 place; no match preview is out yet this far ahead, so this rests on the latest club news. Atalanta's season has been rough: Sarri was under pressure after six games without a win, eased by a 1-0 win at Monza on 8 November, and Atalanta played Inter on Sunday 22 November, so rotation in Banja Luka is possible. Their injury list is shrinking but centre-backs Hien and Kossounou, plus Kristensen and Gaetano, were still training apart on 17 November, while Raspadori and Bellanova are back; the numbers carry no missing players for either side. Borac usually keep the same eleven and play an open game at home; the numbers already count both sides' recent form (Atalanta conceding a lot, Borac collecting cards). No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, with Atalanta scoring about 2. Atalanta's missing centre-backs (Hien, Kossounou) give Borac a little more hope, while Atalanta's own scoring has been poor (8 in their last 6) and possible rotation after Inter could blunt them; the numbers already count both forms, and the two pulls cancel, so I stay at about 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, about 6 for Atalanta. Atalanta should have most of the ball and Borac have been conceding plenty of corners, which the numbers already add through recent form (+9% for Atalanta). Nothing in the news changes Atalanta's wide play, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, and they already raise Borac's share by about 21% for their recent card count. A home side chasing a stronger team tends to foul more, but that is what the numbers already show; no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.7 shots, nearly 19 of them Atalanta's. I lean slightly lower: Atalanta played Inter on Sunday and still have defenders out, so Sarri may rotate and manage the game rather than chase it, and Atalanta have scored little lately. A mild -3% gives about 30.7 shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target, already lifted a little for both sides' recent accuracy. Krstovic has been Atalanta's main scorer and should start whether or not others rotate, and Borac's defence has been giving up chances, so I stay at about 10.3.
